name: hail-hydra
description: Multi-agent orchestration toolkit for AI coding CLIs — Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI. Routes tasks to each host's cost-effective model tiers (Haiku/Sonnet on Claude Code) while the frontier model orchestrates — inspired by speculative decoding. Includes 10 specialized heads, 12 commands, real token tracking, and ~50% API cost reduction. Install via the npm installer (npx hail-hydra-cc) — the supported install path for every host; this repo holds the canonical content/ sources, and per-host payloads are generated into dist/ at build time.
